contract.provides: For an arbitrary finite irreducible continuous-time Markov generator Q, stationary pi and k observed labels, let P be conditional expectation onto label functions in L2(pi), e_a their indicators, M=diag(mu) and C_ab(t)=E_pi[e_a(X0)e_b(Xt)]. L=M^(-1)C-prime(0) is the stationary averaged macro generator. Define b_a=(I-P)Qe_a and Gamma_ab=<b_a,b_b>_pi. The candidate operational result recovers Gamma without observing Q, b or hidden state count, using actual geometric pulses q_ij^(h,a)=q_ij exp[h(e_a(j)-e_a(i))/2], with row sums repaired. This holds symmetric kinetic prefactors fixed; energy changes or detailed-balance ratios alone do not supply the interface.
